translations.idiomatic: He attacked, shattered Deng, and drove him to Mei.

sentences.zh: 登將金槌以新平降萇，萇輕將數百騎入槌營。

translations.literal: Deng's general Jin Chui surrendered Xinping to Chang; Chang with several hundred light riders entered Chui's camp.
translations.idiomatic: Jin Chui handed over Xinping; Chang rode in with a few hundred escorts.

sentences.zh: 群下諫之，萇曰：「槌既去苻登，復欲圖我，將安所歸！

translations.literal: His staff remonstrated; Chang said: "If Chui has left Fu Deng yet also plots against me, where can he turn!
translations.idiomatic: Aides panicked; Chang said, "If Chui betrays Deng only to knife me, he has nowhere left to run!

sentences.zh: 且懷德初附，推款委質，吾復以不信待之，何以禦物乎！

translations.literal: Moreover one newly attached through gratitude and trust—if I meet him with distrust, how shall I command things!
translations.idiomatic: Fresh converts deserve trust—without it I cannot govern anything!"

sentences.zh: 」群氐果有異謀，槌不從而止。

translations.literal: " The mass of Di indeed harbored a separate plot; Chui refused and it stopped.
translations.idiomatic: Di malcontents did scheme; Chui refused and the plot died.

sentences.zh: 萇如陰密攻登，敕其太子興曰：「苟曜好奸變，將為國害，聞吾還北，必來見汝，汝便執之。

translations.literal: Chang went to Yinmi to attack Deng, instructing crown prince Xing: "Gou Yao delights in treacherous shifts and will harm the state; hearing I return north he will surely come to see you—then seize him.
translations.idiomatic: Marching on Yinmi against Deng, Chang warned crown prince Xing, "Gou Yao is viper-shifty—when he visits you under cover of my northern march, arrest him."

sentences.zh: 」苟曜果見興于長安，興遣尹緯讓而誅之。

translations.literal: " Gou Yao indeed met Xing at Chang'an; Xing sent Yin Wei to reproach him and executed him.
translations.idiomatic: Gou Yao appeared in Chang'an; Xing had Yin Wei denounce and execute him.

sentences.zh: 萇大敗登于安定東，置酒高會，諸將咸曰：「若值魏武王，不令此賊至今，陛下將牢太過耳。

translations.literal: Chang utterly defeated Deng east of Anding and raised wine in lofty banquet; all generals said: "Had we met Wei Wuwang we would not have let this bandit survive until today—Your Majesty pens yourself too tightly.
translations.idiomatic: After crushing Deng east of Anding he hosted a triumph; generals muttered, "Had General Wei Wuwang—your brother Yao Xiang—still commanded, Deng would be ash; you shut yourself in too tight."

sentences.zh: 」萇笑曰：「吾不如亡兄有四：身長八尺五寸，臂垂過膝，人望而畏之，一也；

translations.literal: " Chang smiled and said: "I fall short of my dead elder brother in four ways: eight chi five cun in height with arms past the knees—men behold me with awe—that is one;
translations.idiomatic: " Chang laughed, "To my late brother I concede four gifts—first height and reach that cow strangers;

sentences.zh: 當十萬之眾，與天下爭衡，望麾而進，前無橫陣，二也；

translations.literal: Facing a hundred thousand host and wrestling the realm under Heaven—standards advance and no formation bars the front—that is two;
translations.idiomatic: second, courage to spearhead any odds;

sentences.zh: 溫古知今，講論道藝，駕馭英雄，收羅雋異，三也；

translations.literal: surveying antiquity and knowing today, discoursing on arts of the Way, riding heroes and gathering remarkable men—that is three;
translations.idiomatic: third, scholarship that ropes heroes;

sentences.zh: 董率大眾，履險若夷，上下咸允，人盡死力，四也。

translations.literal: ordering great hosts, treading peril as though flat—high and low alike consent and every man spends his utmost—that is four.
translations.idiomatic: fourth, armies that walk cliffs like meadows."

sentences.zh: 所以得建立功業，策任群賢者，正望算略中一片耳。

translations.literal: That I could establish merit and employ worthy ministers hangs solely on a scrap of stratagem within calculation.
translations.idiomatic: " What wins wars for me is not brawn but one slice of scheme."

sentences.zh: 」群臣咸稱萬歲。

translations.literal: " The assembled ministers all cried ten thousand years.
translations.idiomatic: Courtiers roared long life.

sentences.zh: 萇下書令留台諸鎮各置學官，勿有所廢，考試優劣，隨才擢敘。

translations.literal: Chang issued an edict ordering rear headquarters and each garrison to install academicians without abolishing them, examine excellence and defect, and promote according to talent.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered every rear office and post to keep schools running, test pupils, and promote on merit.

sentences.zh: 苻登驃騎將軍沒奕于率戶六千降，拜使持節、車騎將軍、高平公。

translations.literal: Fu Deng's General Who Spreads Might Moyifu led six thousand households to surrender and was appointed credential-bearing inspector, General of Chariots and Cavalry, and Duke of Gaoping.
translations.idiomatic: Moyifu brought six thousand households from Deng's camp and earned credentials as chariot-and-cavalry general and duke of Gaoping.

sentences.zh: 萇寢疾，遣姚碩德鎮李潤，尹緯守長安，召其太子興詣行營。

translations.literal: Chang fell gravely ill; he sent Yao Shuode to hold Lirun, Yin Wei to guard Chang'an, and summoned crown prince Xing to field headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: Bedridden, he stationed Shuode at Lirun, Yin Wei in Chang'an, and called Xing to camp.

sentences.zh: 征南姚方成言於興曰：「今寇賊未滅，上復寢疾，王統、苻胤等皆有部曲，終為人害，宜盡除之。

translations.literal: General Who Conquers the South Yao Fangcheng spoke to Xing: "Bandits are not yet destroyed and the sovereign again lies ill; Wang Tong, Fu Yin and others all retain private troops—they will end as menaces; it is fitting to eliminate them entirely.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Fangcheng urged Xing, "Enemies remain and your father ails—Fu Yin and Wang Tong still command bodies of retainers; purge them."

sentences.zh: 」興於是誅苻胤、王統、王廣、徐成、毛盛，乃赴召。

translations.literal: " Xing then executed Fu Yin, Wang Tong, Wang Guang, Xu Cheng, and Mao Sheng, then answered the summons.
translations.idiomatic: Xing cut down Fu Yin, Wang Tong, Wang Guang, Xu Cheng, and Mao Sheng before riding to camp.

sentences.zh: 興至，萇怒曰：「王統兄弟是吾州裏，無他遠志，徐成等昔在秦朝，並為名將。

translations.literal: When Xing arrived Chang angrily said: "The Wang Tong brothers are men of my province without distant ambition; Xu Cheng and others in former Qin times together were famed generals.
translations.idiomatic: Chang raged at him: "Wang Tong's clan are neighbors without lofty plots; Xu Cheng's crowd were Qin stars."

sentences.zh: 天下小定，吾方任之，奈何輒便誅害，令人喪氣！」

translations.literal: With the realm slightly settled I was about to employ them—how could you rashly slaughter them and chill men's spirits!"
translations.idiomatic: " Peace was near and I planned to employ them—why slaughter them and crush morale!"

sentences.zh: 萇下書，兵吏從征伐，戶在大營者，世世復其家，無所豫。

translations.literal: Chang issued an edict: soldiers and clerks who followed campaigns and households belonging to the Great Camp shall generation after generation have their families exempted without levies.
translations.idiomatic: He exempted forever every household tied to the Great Camp host.

sentences.zh: 苻登與竇沖相持，萇議擊之，尹緯言於萇曰：「太子純厚之稱，著于遐邇，將領英略，未為遠近所知。

translations.literal: Fu Deng locked horns with Dou Chong; Chang debated striking him; Yin Wei said to Chang: "The crown prince's reputation for purity and generosity is famed far and near; his martial designs are not yet known near and far.
translations.idiomatic: As Deng fenced with Dou Chong, Yin Wei advised, "The heir is loved for kindness but untested as commander."

sentences.zh: 宜遣太子親行，可以漸廣威武，防窺窬之原。

translations.literal: It is fitting to dispatch the crown prince in person—thus may martial awe gradually broaden and block the springs of covetous intrigue.
translations.idiomatic: Let him lead an army—spread dread abroad and choke intrigue."

sentences.zh: 」萇從之，戎興曰：「賊徒知汝轉近，必相驅入堡，聚而掩之，無不克矣。

translations.literal: " Chang followed this counsel and instructed Xing: "When bandits learn you are drawing near they will surely herd into forts; gather and ambush them—none will withstand you.
translations.idiomatic: Chang agreed and coached Xing: "Let Deng learn you march—he will herd his men behind walls; then bundle and crush them."

sentences.zh: 」比至胡空堡，沖圍自解。

translations.literal: " By the time he reached Kongkong Fort of the Hu, Chong's siege dissolved of itself.
translations.idiomatic: When Xing neared Kongkong Fort, Dou Chong's ring broke without a blow.

sentences.zh: 登聞興向胡空堡，引還，興因襲平涼，大獲而歸，咸如萇策。

translations.literal: Deng heard Xing was bound for Kongkong Fort and withdrew; Xing thereupon raided Pingliang, took great booty, and returned—all as Chang had planned.
translations.idiomatic: Deng retreated at news of Xing; Xing swept Pingliang for spoil exactly as Chang scripted.

sentences.zh: 使興還鎮長安。

translations.literal: He sent Xing back to guard Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: He returned Xing to the capital garrison.

sentences.zh: 萇下書除妖謗之言及赦前奸穢，有相劾舉者，皆以其罪罪之。

translations.literal: Chang issued an edict abolishing talk of omens and slander and prior amnesty for foul crimes—whoever impeaches another on these grounds suffers the same crime.
translations.idiomatic: He banned rumor-mongering about portents and forbade recycling old amnesties—false denunciation earns the denouncer's penalty.

sentences.zh: 晉平遠將軍、護氐校尉楊佛嵩率胡蜀三千餘戶降于萇，晉將楊佺期、趙睦追之。

translations.literal: Jin's General Who Pacifies the Distance and Colonel of the Di Yang Fosong led more than three thousand Hu and Shu households to surrender to Chang; Jin generals Yang Quanqi and Zhao Mu pursued.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Fosong of Jin brought Di and Shu settlers to Chang; Yang Quanqi and Zhao Mu gave chase.

sentences.zh: 遣姚崇赴救，大敗晉師，斬趙睦。

translations.literal: Chang sent Yao Chong to rescue; he utterly defeated Jin forces and beheaded Zhao Mu.
translations.idiomatic: Yao Chong rode to the rescue, shattered the Jin column, and took Zhao Mu's head.

sentences.zh: 以佛嵩為鎮東將軍。

translations.literal: He appointed Fosong General Who Guards the East.
translations.idiomatic: Fosong became general who guards the east.

sentences.zh: 萇如長安，至於新支堡，疾篤，輿疾而進。

translations.literal: Chang went to Chang'an; reaching Xinzhi Fort his illness turned severe; he advanced by litter though ill.
translations.idiomatic: Bound for Chang'an, he collapsed at Xinzhi Fort and pressed on in a litter.

sentences.zh: 夢苻堅將天官使者、鬼兵數百突入營中，萇懼，走入宮，宮人迎萇刺鬼，誤中萇陰，鬼相謂曰：「正中死處。

translations.literal: He dreamed Fu Jian led several hundred celestial officials and ghost soldiers bursting into camp; Chang fled in fear into the palace; palace women welcomed Chang and stabbed ghosts but mistakenly struck Chang's groin; the ghosts said to each other: "Right on the fatal spot.
translations.idiomatic: He dreamed Fu Jian charged camp with hundreds of sky-clerk ghosts; fleeing indoors, harem women lunged at shades and speared his groin by mistake—the spirits whispered, "Right on the fatal spot."

sentences.zh: 」拔矛，出血石餘。

translations.literal: " They drew the lance; blood flowed more than a stone's measure.
translations.idiomatic: They wrenched the spear free and blood gushed a stone's weight.

sentences.zh: 寤而驚悸，遂患陰腫，醫刺之，出血如夢。

translations.literal: Awakening in terror he then suffered groin swelling; physicians lanced it and blood flowed as in the dream.
translations.idiomatic: He woke swollen; doctors lanced him and the flow matched the nightmare.

sentences.zh: 萇遂狂言，或稱「臣萇，殺陛下者兄襄，非臣之罪，願不枉臣。

translations.literal: Chang then raved, sometimes saying "Your minister Chang—he who killed Your Majesty was elder brother Xiang, not your minister's crime; pray do not wrong your minister.
translations.idiomatic: Delirious, he shrieked that Xiang killed Fu Jian, not he—begging the ghost's pardon."

sentences.zh: 」至長安，召太尉姚旻、尚書左僕射尹緯、右僕射姚晃、尚書狄伯支等入，受遺輔政。

translations.literal: Reaching Chang'an he summoned Grand Commandant Yao Min, Left Minister Yin Wei, Right Minister Yao Huang, Minister Di Bozhi and others to enter and receive testamentary charge to assist government.
translations.idiomatic: In Chang'an he gathered Yao Min, Yin Wei, Yao Huang, Di Bozhi, and charged them as regents.

sentences.zh: 萇謂興曰：「有毀此諸人者，慎勿受之。

translations.literal: Chang told Xing: "Should anyone slander these men, beware—do not accept it.
translations.idiomatic: He warned Xing never to heed slurs against those ministers."

sentences.zh: 汝撫骨肉以仁，接大臣以禮，待物以信，遇黔首以恩，四者既備，吾無憂矣。

translations.literal: Treat flesh-and-bone with kindness, receive great ministers with ritual, deal with things with trust, encounter black-haired commoners with kindness—when these four are prepared I have no worry.
translations.idiomatic: " Love kin, honor ministers, keep faith, cherish the people—master that and I rest easy."

sentences.zh: 」乙太元十八年死，時年六十四，在位八年。

translations.literal: In Taiyuan's eighteenth year he died, aged sixty-four, having reigned eight years.
translations.idiomatic: Taiyuan eighteenth year claimed him at sixty-four after eight years on the throne.

sentences.zh: 偽諡武昭皇帝，廟號太祖，墓稱原陵。

translations.literal: His false posthumous title was Emperor Wuzhao with temple name Taizu and tomb called Yuanling.
translations.idiomatic: Histories record temple name Taizu, posthumous Emperor Wuzhao, tomb Yuanling.
